conditions: Put this attribution on the Credits screen: "Easy Lemon Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) / Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 / https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/". The incompetech FAQ names a "Credits" screen as the usual place for credits. Under CC BY 4.0 s.2(a)(5)(B) you may not add DRM or extra terms that restrict what downstream users can do. Hosting the file in a public R2 bucket meets that. If you trim or edit the file to make the loop, the credit must say it was modified (CC BY 4.0 s.3(a)(1)(B), and the incompetech FAQ asks that the credits make clear what you changed). No Premium, region or payment conditions apply.
